summary: Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS, x86_64, 1 CPU, 984 MiB memory, 19.1 GiB disk free

findings.remedy: Add a 1 GiB swap file so a memory spike slows the server instead of stopping apps.

fix.summary: Create /swapfile (1 GiB), enable it and add it to /etc/fstab

findings.remedy: Install Docker Engine from Docker's official package repository.

fix.summary: Install Docker Engine from Docker's apt repository and start it

findings.required: ports 80 and 443 free for OAP's Caddy
findings.remedy: Decide what happens to nginx: stop it, move it, or run it behind OAP. OAP doesn't stop software it didn't install.

findings.required: a synchronized clock (certificates and tokens depend on it)
